title: 508. K-th Smallest in Lexicographical Order

examples.explanation: Dictionary order begins 1, 10, 11, 12, 13, 2, .... The second entry is 10.

hints: Think of numbers as a ten-way tree where children of x are x*10 through x*10+9.
Count how many values sit under a prefix without visiting each one, then skip whole subtrees or dive deeper.
Decrease k as you consume prefixes or descend, stopping when k reaches zero.
